meta.title: Bill Formatter — XML Ingestion, Invoice Generation, Delivery & Configuration

lanes.name: Mediation Zone / Oracle BRM
lanes.hint: Upstream billing source supplying regular, trial and hot bill XML

lanes.name: Bill Formatter (DXP)
lanes.hint: Core engine — XML validation, parsing, batch creation, invoice generation, masking, reports

lanes.name: Bill Formatter Portal / Admin Console
lanes.hint: Batch, bill, hot bill, XML, search and configuration consoles used by Billing Operations

lanes.name: Billing Operations User
lanes.hint: Reviews failures, retries, configures templates and reference data, approves invoices

lanes.name: Siebel CRM
lanes.hint: Hot bill landing location, reprint/resend request origin, notification logging

lanes.name: Delivery Channels
lanes.hint: SMS, WhatsApp Business, Web and Email (via SMTP) to the customer

nodes.label: Retrieve XML (Regular / Trial / Hot)
nodes.desc: Formatter pulls invoice XML from the Mediation Zone predefined file location for regular, trial and hot bills, validates the XML format, processes retrieval batch-wise, prevents duplicate XML processing and logs retrieval status. Uses an atomic write pattern (temp location/filename, write, close, verify, then rename/move to final destination) so no partially written XML is ever readable downstream.
inputs: Invoice XML at MZ predefined location
outputs: Retrieved XML file ready for validation

nodes.label: Data Ingestion (XML or DB Table)
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter must have the capability to ingest data for invoice generation either as XML or directly from a database table, the exact mechanism to be decided at design time.
inputs: Invoice source data — XML or DB table (TBD)
outputs: Ingested data ready for invoice generation

nodes.label: Manual XML/ZIP Upload
nodes.desc: Authorised users may upload invoice XML/ZIP files manually through the Bill Formatter Portal as an alternative to automated BRM/Mediation Zone pickup. Batch creation/upload is restricted to authorised users.

nodes.label: Validate XML (Schema + Mandatory Data)
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter loads the XML and performs schema validation to ensure file structure is valid, then validates mandatory billing information required for invoice generation. Only XML passing both checks proceeds to invoice generation; a failure is marked Failed XML with a recorded reason and made visible in the Bill Formatter Portal for reprocessing after corrective action.

branches.label: Failed XML — schema or data invalid

nodes.label: Failed XML — Portal Visibility & Reprocess
nodes.desc: Failed XML records are visible in the Bill Formatter Portal with an associated failure reason and processing status. Billing Operations users review failed XML records and initiate reprocessing after corrective action; retry/reprocess capability is required. Batch statistics and processing status are updated to reflect successful and failed XML outcomes.
inputs: Failed XML with recorded failure reason

nodes.label: Parse & Load XML
nodes.desc: Parses the validated XML and loads the Invoice Header, Invoice Summary and Invoice Details. Captures a log for tracking the loading process.

nodes.label: Supporting CSV Detection
nodes.desc: System detects when a supporting CSV file (expected alongside certain XML) is not received. A scheduler checks every 10 minutes (P-01); if the supporting CSV is still missing four hours after XML receipt (P-02), an alert email is sent to configured recipients.

nodes.label: Create Batch
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter receives invoice XML files either through automated batch pickup from BRM/Mediation Zone or manual XML/ZIP upload, loads the received XML files and creates a processing batch. Batch creation/upload is restricted to authorised users.
inputs: Retrieved or manually uploaded XML files
outputs: Processing batch ready for invoice generation

nodes.label: Batch Console
nodes.desc: Provides Billing Operations users with visibility of batch processing status, invoice generation status, email delivery status and XML processing status for a selected batch, at both batch level and bill/invoice level. Status values: Failed, Ready, Report Generated, Invoice (PDF/XLS/CSV) Completed, Email Sent, Failed Sending Email, Failed XML Data.

nodes.label: Batch Action Menu
nodes.desc: Batch-level action menu: View Bills, View Statistics, Overall Report, Detail Report, Failed Report, Failed Email Report, Send Overall Report, Send Email. Each option triggers its corresponding action.

nodes.label: Bill Action Menu (Batch Console)
nodes.desc: Selecting View Bill from the Batch Action Menu lists bill details (Id, Process Date, Bill No, Status, Email, Total Size, This Month Due, Total Due, Action). Each bill row then exposes its own Action Menu: Status Log, Download PDF, Download XLS, Download XML, Reprint Bill, Regenerate Document, Regenerate XML, Send Email. Configurable list of non-triable (skipped) email IDs suppresses email trigger where applicable.
outputs: Bill list with per-bill Status Log / Download PDF / Download XLS / Download XML / Reprint Bill / Regenerate Document / Regenerate XML / Send Email

nodes.label: Batch Reports (Overall / Detailed / Statistics)
nodes.desc: Overall Batch Report summarises each generated bill/document per batch (delivery preference code 0=PDF only, 3=PDF+XLS; document id unique per document). Detailed Batch Report aggregates plan/extras/payment/dues at bill level with account tab and service-specific tabs. View Statistics shows successful vs failed PDF counts with reasons. Failed Report and Failed Email Report are downloadable in XLS. Hot Bill Generation Failed Report runs on a 4-hour interval (P-03) checking uploaded hot bills for failed status.

nodes.label: Generate Invoice (Bill Type x Segment x Format)
nodes.desc: Extracts the invoice template for the applicable customer segment (Consumer Mobile, Consumer Fixed Line, Enterprise, Black, Bulk SMS, IoT) and bill type (Regular, Trial, Hot), then generates the invoice in the required output format (PDF in English/Arabic, XLS, CSV) per BF to identify the language type identifier. Enterprise outputs additionally generate a Call Detail CSV. Regular and Hot Bill outputs are sent to Siebel; Trial Bill output is stored internally for audit/validation only and not sent to the customer.

nodes.label: Invoice Generation Failed — Retry
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter identifies invoices that failed during processing or invoice generation, records the failure status and makes the failure information available in the Bill Formatter Portal. Billing Operations reviews failed invoices and retries; retry/reprocess is role-based.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Generation Failed Alert
nodes.desc: Identifies failed hot bill generation and sends an email alert/report. Runs daily on a four-hour interval, checking uploaded hot bills for failed status.

nodes.label: Review & Approve Invoice
nodes.desc: Role-based users review generated invoices/documents and approve or reject them before customer despatch, via search in the Bill Formatter Portal. Governed by an on/off review-and-approval switch, default OFF (P-12).

nodes.label: Regenerate Invoice
nodes.desc: Billing Operations initiates an invoice regeneration request for a specific invoice or batch; Bill Formatter validates the selection and, where the source XML has been regenerated or corrected, reprocesses it. Regeneration includes retry and status reporting.

nodes.label: Make Invoice Available to Channels
nodes.desc: After successful invoice processing, Bill Formatter generates the invoice output in the required format (PDF/XLS/CSV based on invoice type and customer segment) and makes it available to downstream channels. Trial batches are excluded from channel upload; Hot Bill availability is real-time after generation; Regular Bill invoices are made available to Siebel and other supported customer channels.

nodes.label: Apply Masking Before Despatch
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter generates and stores the original invoice output after successful generation, then generates a separate masked invoice file for applicable invoice types based on configured masking rules. The original customer invoice remains unchanged and immutable; sensitive information is masked in the despatched copy per configured rules.

nodes.label: Multi-Channel Invoice Communication
nodes.desc: Supports invoice communication through SMS, WhatsApp Business, Web Channel and Email. Invoice messages may include PDF or a URL-based invoice reference and apply customer-specific masking rules before despatch. WhatsApp Business access, BSP approval, pricing and privacy/regulatory guidelines are managed by VF.

nodes.label: Determine Email Eligibility & Template
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter identifies invoices eligible for email distribution after successful generation and determines the applicable email template based on customer type, invoice type and language, then attaches the generated invoice document. Trial invoices do not trigger email; only successfully generated invoices are eligible.

nodes.label: Send Invoice Email (SMTP)
nodes.desc: Attaches the generated invoice document (PDF/XLS/CSV) and despatches via SMTP integration, in the applicable language (English and Arabic supported). Dynamic email fields are configurable; a configurable list of non-triable (skipped) email IDs prevents despatch to excluded addresses.

nodes.label: Failed Email — Report & Retry
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter reports total successful and failed emails per batch, account-wise and bill-wise, and provides a Failed Email Report highlighting addresses for which the bill email could not be sent or attempted. Report includes exclusion-list scenarios and invalid/failure scenarios; SMTP delivery failure capture depends on SMTP response/report data.

nodes.label: CRM Notification Logging
nodes.desc: After an invoice email is sent, Bill Formatter creates a notification log entry containing the invoice reference and email communication details, and sends the notification to Siebel CRM. A CRM notification record is created only for invoices processed for customer communication.

nodes.label: Reprint Request from CRM
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter receives a bill reprint request from CRM with account number, bill period and bill type details.
inputs: Reprint request (account number, bill period, bill type)
outputs: Reprint request queued in Bill Formatter

nodes.label: Reprint Bill Console
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter retrieves the XML, generates the PDF and transfers it to the Mediation Zone, from where it goes to CRM for delivery to the customer. Console shows all reprints given: Id, Process Date, Bill Number, Status, Email, Total Size, This Month Due, Total Due. Reprint does not alter original invoice data; only an existing bill can be reprinted, with Detailed/Summarised type selection.
outputs: Reprinted PDF transferred via MZ to CRM

nodes.label: Reprint Bill Action Menu
nodes.desc: Per-reprint-record action menu: Status Log, Download PDF, Download XLS, Download XML, Reprint Bill (with Bill type Summary/Detailed and Language English/Arabic input), Regenerate Document, Regenerate XML, Send Email.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Register
nodes.desc: Displays hot bill details: Id, Process Date, Bill No, Status, Email, Total Size, This Month Due, Total Due, Action. Upon receipt of a Hot Bill request from Siebel CRM, BRM calculates current billable charges and generates an invoice XML in the designated Bill Formatter input location.
inputs: Hot bill request from Siebel CRM

nodes.label: Hot Bill Action Menu
nodes.desc: Per-hot-bill action menu: Status Log, Download PDF, Download XLS, Download XML, Reprint Bill, Regenerate Document, Regenerate XML, Send Email.

nodes.label: Resend Request from Customer/CRM
nodes.desc: Customer requests a bill resend through Siebel CRM for a previously generated invoice. Siebel invokes the Bill Formatter Resend Bill service, passing the account number and bill reference. Only previously generated invoices can be resent; existing API signature remains unchanged to support parallel run.

nodes.label: Resend Invoice Email
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter validates the bill reference, retrieves the previously generated invoice document and resends it by email. Resend template can differ from the first-time email template. Email delivery outcome is captured for status reporting.

nodes.label: Resend Bill Status Console
nodes.desc: Shows resend bill status in a separate console option: Sl No, Bill Number, Status, Process Date. Action menu offers Edit of the resend bill template per record.

nodes.label: Invoice & Report Search
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter supports invoice/report search using filters: invoice type, invoice number, batch, date, language, MSISDN, product, status, email, account, customer type, and BF Id (internal). Search results allow download; available actions depend on user role and invoice status.

nodes.label: XML Record Search
nodes.desc: Billing Operations searches uploaded bill XML records by Invoice Type, Invoice Number, Batch ID and other criteria. Search results display the latest XML processing status available in Bill Formatter.
outputs: Matching XML records with latest status

nodes.label: Console Search
nodes.desc: General console search with parameters: Document type, Status, Language, MSISDN, Account No, Email, Bill Number, Customer Type, with page control (min/max page). Page listings additionally support column-header sorting in ascending/descending order.

nodes.label: Generate Reports (Enterprise / Operational / Business)
nodes.desc: Generates Enterprise reports (GE Reports), operational reports and business reports, emailed using configured templates on Daily/Monthly/After Bill Run/Adhoc frequency in PDF/CSV/Excel format. Includes large-enterprise customer-specific reports (CDR_LIST_REPORT, CREDIT_FILE_REPORT, INVOICE_REPORT) and scheduled templates (Bill Run Monitor, VLB, Overall, Internal, Video Bill).

nodes.label: Download / Export Report
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter allows report download or export in PDF and Excel formats, making generated reports available to Billing Operations users.

nodes.label: Operational Dashboard & Statistics
nodes.desc: Provides operational statistics for successful and failed invoices by batch, split by Consumer and Enterprise, plus average bill size statistics. Graphical representation in Admin Console defaults to current month for Large Bills, Failed XMLs, Daily Resend Bill, Monthly volumes. Includes Failed Email Report export.

nodes.label: Billing Reports Accounts Manager
nodes.desc: Business Users configure, modify or delete report types per account number (Account Name, Report Type, List of Account Numbers). Enterprise billing reports are generated only for accounts configured here.
inputs: Account name, report type, account number list

nodes.label: Admin Console — Centralised Configuration
nodes.desc: Front-end Admin Console for Billing Operations covering batches, bills, hot bills, XML records, reports, translations, billing settings and role-based access. Configuration records drill down centrally — selecting a batch id opens the invoices belonging to that batch, and configuration records open in a separate window/pop-up.

nodes.label: Reference Data Configuration
nodes.desc: Configuration of Adjustment Reasons (create/edit codes and labels), Benefits (auto-updated product list from BRM XML, create/search benefits), Flex Bucket IDs (import/export/create, edit/delete sub-menu) and VAS Short Codes (mapped by Called_To/Record_Type, search, edit/delete). Each reference-data type exposes its own create/search/action-menu (Edit/Delete) sub-options.
inputs: Adjustment reason, benefit, flex bucket, VAS short code inputs
outputs: Configured reference-data records feeding invoice generation

nodes.label: Configuration Import / Export & Effective Dating
nodes.desc: Billing Operations exports selected configuration data in XLS or CSV format and imports it back; configuration maintenance is controlled by role. Configuration activation/inactivation is controlled using Active From / Active To effective dates.

nodes.label: Bill Template & Banner Configuration
nodes.desc: Translation configuration (source/destination values, self-updating from XML fields), bill email template configuration (separate Consumer/Enterprise templates, first-time vs resend, English/Arabic), bill template change (cosmetic redesign per business look-and-feel), bill banner configuration, plan speed configuration (synced with product catalogue), and full Bill Template Redesign covering field position/visibility changes per invoice section, customer segment and invoice type.
outputs: Configured templates, translations, banners and plan speed feeding invoice generation

nodes.label: Report Template Configuration
nodes.desc: Billing Operations creates, modifies or deletes report templates and configures attributes (recipients, subject, body). Configured templates are used when sending reports to mail IDs, covering Bill Run Monitor, VLB, Overall, Internal and Video Bill templates.
outputs: Configured report templates feeding report generation

nodes.label: Masking Rule Configuration
nodes.desc: Configures the masking rules applied to sensitive invoice information before despatch, plus the invoice template's own business rules and calculated-field logic for fields not directly available from source systems.

nodes.label: Platform Services Configuration
nodes.desc: Storage and retention with automatic housekeeping of artefacts past their retention period; multi-language support (English/Arabic template + translation values); multi-currency support (invoice generated using the currency provided in source data, beyond Qatari Riyal); tax information processing sourced from BRM XML/database; and compatibility handling to reproduce old/legacy invoices as available in BRM.
inputs: Retention policy, language/currency/tax settings, legacy format rules
outputs: Storage housekeeping, language/currency/tax application at generation, legacy invoice reproduction

nodes.label: Interactive PDF Configuration
nodes.desc: Configures moving current bill sections into PDF tabs for one-click navigation, and interactive PDF features with graphical information and dynamic links, where required.
outputs: Interactive PDF tab/link configuration feeding generation

nodes.label: Template Business-Rule Documentation
nodes.desc: All invoice field definitions, rules and business logic governing the invoice template are exposed and made accessible to non-technical users in a business-readable format, matching the current template's documentation.

start.title: XML Ready in Mediation Zone
start.does: Marks the point at which regular, trial or hot bill invoice XML is available at the Mediation Zone predefined input location for Bill Formatter to retrieve.
start.needs: Invoice XML produced upstream by Oracle BRM
start.makes: XML available at MZ predefined location

xml_retrieve.title: Retrieve XML (Regular / Trial / Hot)
xml_retrieve.does: Pulls invoice XML from MZ/BRM for regular, trial and hot bills using an atomic write-then-rename pattern so no partial file is ever read downstream; processes batch-wise, prevents duplicate processing, and logs retrieval status.
xml_retrieve.needs: Invoice XML at MZ predefined location
xml_retrieve.makes: Retrieved XML file ready for validation; retrieval log entry

xml_ingest_alt.title: Data Ingestion (XML or DB Table)
xml_ingest_alt.does: Bill Formatter must be able to ingest invoice source data either as XML or from a database table; the specific ingestion mechanism is to be decided at design time.
xml_ingest_alt.needs: Invoice source data (XML or DB table)

xml_manual_upload.title: Manual XML/ZIP Upload
xml_manual_upload.does: Authorised users can manually upload invoice XML/ZIP files as an alternative to automated pickup from BRM/Mediation Zone.

xml_validate.title: Validate XML (Schema + Mandatory Data)
xml_validate.does: Loads the XML and performs schema validation to ensure the file structure is valid, then validates mandatory billing information required for invoice generation. Only XML that passes both checks proceeds; a failure is marked Failed XML with a recorded reason, visible in the Portal for reprocessing.
xml_validate.makes: Valid XML routed to parsing, or Failed XML with reason recorded

xml_failed.title: Failed XML — Portal Visibility & Reprocess
xml_failed.does: Failed XML records are shown in the Bill Formatter Portal with the failure reason; Billing Operations reviews them and initiates reprocessing after correction. Batch statistics reflect the failed outcome.

xml_parse.title: Parse & Load XML
xml_parse.does: Parses the validated XML and loads Invoice Header, Invoice Summary and Invoice Details, capturing a tracking log of the loading process.

csv_watch.title: Supporting CSV Detection
csv_watch.does: Detects when a supporting CSV file expected alongside an XML is not received; scheduler checks every 10 minutes and alerts after a 4-hour absence threshold.
csv_watch.needs: Expected supporting CSV linked to an XML

batch_create.title: Create Batch
batch_create.does: Loads received XML files (automated pickup or manual upload) and creates a processing batch, restricted to authorised users.

batch_console.title: Batch Console
batch_console.does: Gives Billing Operations visibility of batch, invoice, email and XML processing status at batch and bill level, with the full status vocabulary (Failed/Ready/Report Generated/Invoice Completed/Email Sent/Failed Sending Email/Failed XML Data).
batch_console.example: BFR_SEQ_012; BFR_SEQ_014; BFR_SEQ_065; BFR_SEQ_067; BR-072; BR-073

batch_action_menu.title: Batch Action Menu
batch_action_menu.does: Per-batch action menu offering View Bills, View Statistics, Overall/Detail/Failed/Failed Email reports, Send Overall Report and Send Email; each option triggers its corresponding action.

bill_action_menu.title: Bill Action Menu (Batch Console)
bill_action_menu.does: Lists bill-level detail under a batch and exposes a per-bill action menu (Status Log, Download PDF/XLS/XML, Reprint Bill, Regenerate Document/XML, Send Email), honouring a configurable non-triable email suppression list.
bill_action_menu.makes: Bill list and per-bill action outcomes

batch_reports.title: Batch Reports (Overall / Detailed / Statistics)
batch_reports.does: Produces Overall, Detailed, Statistics, Failed and Failed Email batch reports (XLS) plus a 4-hourly Hot Bill Generation Failed report.
batch_reports.makes: Downloadable XLS reports; hot-bill failure alert

invoice_generate.title: Generate Invoice (Bill Type x Segment x Format)
invoice_generate.does: Generates PDF/XLS/CSV invoice output across Regular/Trial/Hot bill types and Consumer Mobile/Fixed/Enterprise/Black/Bulk SMS/IoT segments in English and Arabic; Trial output stays internal for audit, Regular/Hot output goes to Siebel.
invoice_generate.needs: Loaded invoice data, template, language/segment/format selection
invoice_generate.example: BFR_SEQ_035-060; BFR_SEQ_088; BFR_SEQ_089; BR-020 to BR-028

invoice_gen_failed.title: Invoice Generation Failed — Retry
invoice_gen_failed.does: Records invoice generation failures with reason in the Portal; Billing Operations reviews and retries under role-based control.

hotbill_failed_report.title: Hot Bill Generation Failed Alert
hotbill_failed_report.does: Identifies failed hot bill generation on a 4-hour interval and emails an alert/report.
hotbill_failed_report.makes: Email alert of failed hot bills

invoice_review.title: Review & Approve Invoice
invoice_review.does: Role-based reviewers approve or reject generated invoices before despatch; controlled by an on/off switch defaulting to OFF.
invoice_review.makes: Approve (proceeds to delivery) or Reject (routes to regeneration)

invoice_regenerate.title: Regenerate Invoice
invoice_regenerate.does: Validates and reprocesses a regeneration request for a specific invoice/batch, particularly where the source XML has been corrected, with retry and status reporting.

channel_avail.title: Make Invoice Available to Channels
channel_avail.does: Makes the generated invoice output available to downstream channels; trial batches excluded, hot bills real-time, regular bills to Siebel and other channels.

invoice_masking_dispatch.title: Apply Masking Before Despatch
invoice_masking_dispatch.does: Generates a masked copy of the invoice for despatch per configured masking rules, while the original invoice remains unchanged and immutable.

multi_channel_send.title: Multi-Channel Invoice Communication
multi_channel_send.does: Delivers invoices via SMS, WhatsApp Business and Web Channel, using PDF attachment or URL-based reference with masking applied.

email_eligibility.title: Determine Email Eligibility & Template
email_eligibility.does: Determines whether an invoice is eligible for email distribution and selects the template by customer type, invoice type and language; trial invoices are excluded.
email_eligibility.makes: Eligible invoice with selected template, or suppressed

email_send.title: Send Invoice Email (SMTP)
email_send.does: Attaches the invoice document and sends it via SMTP in English or Arabic per the selected template, honouring the non-triable email suppression list.
email_send.example: BFR_SEQ_094; BFR_SEQ_144; BFR_SEQ_145; BFR_SEQ_185; BR-062; BR-063

email_failed.title: Failed Email — Report & Retry
email_failed.does: Reports failed email despatch (account-wise, bill-wise) via a Failed Email Report and enables resend.

crm_notify_log.title: CRM Notification Logging
crm_notify_log.does: Logs invoice reference and email communication details to Siebel CRM after despatch, for invoices processed for customer communication.

end_delivered.title: Invoice Delivered
end_delivered.does: Terminal state marking successful invoice delivery to the customer through any supported channel.

reprint_request.title: Reprint Request from CRM
reprint_request.does: Receives a bill reprint request from CRM carrying account number, bill period and bill type.

reprint_console.title: Reprint Bill Console
reprint_console.does: Retrieves the XML, regenerates the PDF and routes it through MZ back to CRM for customer delivery; lists all reprints given without altering original invoice data.
reprint_console.makes: Reprinted PDF via MZ to CRM

reprint_action_menu.title: Reprint Bill Action Menu
reprint_action_menu.does: Per-record reprint actions: status log, downloads (PDF/XLS/XML), reprint (type + language selection), regenerate document/XML, send email.

hotbill_console.title: Hot Bill Register
hotbill_console.does: Lists hot bill records with status/size/due details; hot bills originate from a Siebel CRM request that triggers BRM to calculate charges and produce invoice XML.

hotbill_action_menu.title: Hot Bill Action Menu
hotbill_action_menu.does: Per-hot-bill actions mirroring the batch console action set: status log, downloads, reprint, regenerate, send email.

resend_request.title: Resend Request from Customer/CRM
resend_request.does: Customer-initiated resend request via Siebel CRM, passing account number and bill reference to Bill Formatter's Resend Bill service.

resend_send.title: Resend Invoice Email
resend_send.does: Validates the bill reference, retrieves the previously generated invoice and resends it by email using the resend-specific template.

resend_console.title: Resend Bill Status Console
resend_console.does: Displays resend status per bill (Sl No, Bill Number, Status, Process Date) with an Edit action on the resend bill template.

invoice_search.title: Invoice & Report Search
invoice_search.does: Multi-filter search across invoice type, number, batch, date, language, MSISDN, product, status, email, account, customer type and internal BF Id, with role-dependent actions on results.

xml_search.title: XML Record Search
xml_search.does: Searches uploaded bill XML records by invoice type/number/batch and shows the latest processing status.

console_search.title: Console Search
console_search.does: Cross-console search by document type, status, language, MSISDN, account, email, bill number and customer type, with page control and header-driven sort order.

reports_generate.title: Generate Reports (Enterprise / Operational / Business)
reports_generate.does: Produces enterprise, operational and business reports on configured schedules and formats, including large-enterprise customer-specific report types and named scheduled templates (Bill Run Monitor, VLB, Overall, Internal, Video Bill).

reports_download.title: Download / Export Report
reports_download.does: Makes generated reports available for download/export in PDF and Excel formats.

dashboard.title: Operational Dashboard & Statistics
dashboard.does: Graphical operational statistics (successful/failed invoices, average bill size, large bills, failed XMLs, daily resend) split Consumer/Enterprise, defaulting to current month.

reports_account_mgr.title: Billing Reports Accounts Manager
reports_account_mgr.does: Lets Business Users configure which accounts receive which enterprise report types.

config_console.title: Admin Console — Centralised Configuration
config_console.does: Unified Admin Console for Billing Ops covering batches, bills, hot bills, XML, reports, translations and settings, with drill-down navigation into records.

config_reference_data.title: Reference Data Configuration
config_reference_data.does: Maintains Adjustment Reason, Benefits, Flex Bucket ID and VAS Short Code reference data (create/search/edit/delete) that invoice generation consumes.

config_import_export.title: Configuration Import / Export & Effective Dating
config_import_export.does: Exports/imports configuration in XLS/CSV and controls activation/inactivation via effective From/To dates.

config_templates.title: Bill Template & Banner Configuration
config_templates.does: Configures translations, email templates (first-time/resend, English/Arabic), bill template redesign/cosmetic changes, banners and plan speed — all feeding invoice generation and presentation.
config_templates.example: BFR_SEQ_116; BFR_SEQ_121; BFR_SEQ_122; BFR_SEQ_125; BFR_SEQ_129; BFR_SEQ_178; BFR_SEQ_182; BFR_SEQ_188; BR-100; BR-101; BR-102; BR-107; BR-120; BR-121; BR-122

config_report_templates.title: Report Template Configuration
config_report_templates.does: Creates/edits/deletes report templates (recipients, subject, body) used when despatching scheduled reports.

config_masking_rules.title: Masking Rule Configuration
config_masking_rules.does: Defines masking rules for despatched invoices and the calculated-field logic used where source data alone is insufficient.
config_masking_rules.example: BFR_SEQ_098; BFR_SEQ_100; BFR_SEQ_141; BR-031; BR-151; BR-152; BR-153; BR-163

config_platform.title: Platform Services Configuration
config_platform.does: Storage/retention housekeeping, multi-language, multi-currency, tax processing and old-invoice compatibility — platform-level settings that invoice generation draws on.
config_platform.makes: Applied platform configuration at generation time
config_platform.example: BFR_SEQ_135; BFR_SEQ_136; BFR_SEQ_137; BFR_SEQ_140; BFR_SEQ_146; BR-160; BR-161; BR-162; P-13 to P-18

config_interactive_pdf.title: Interactive PDF Configuration
config_interactive_pdf.does: Configures PDF section tabs and dynamic/graphical links for interactive invoice navigation.

config_template_docs.title: Template Business-Rule Documentation
config_template_docs.does: Exposes invoice template field definitions and business rules in business-readable form for non-technical users.

end_rejected.title: Invoice Rejected / Exception Terminal
end_rejected.does: Terminal state for XML or invoices that remain unrecoverable after exhausted retries/reprocessing attempts.
